items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I hadn’t met Philly Joe either! ... He was probably one of the first people, barring Kenny Clarke, Philly Joe, and Art Blakey... Joe used to hang out there a lot. ... So you met Kenny Clarke and Philly Joe

ctx.x: So he invited you over to his place to look at it? Had you met Kenny before that?
No I hadn’t. I hadn’t met Philly Joe either! (Laughs) Kenny just said, “Come on over!”
